references.text: Beth-peor is mentioned as the place where Israel began to worship Baal-peor, which led to God's judgment on the people.
Israel camped in the valley at Beth-peor after they had defeated King Sihon and King Og.
Beth-peor is mentioned as part of the area Israel took under Moses' leadership on the east side of the Jordan.
Moses was buried in the valley in the land of Moab, opposite Beth-peor.
Mount Pisgah is mentioned as the place where Balak brought Balaam to curse Israel.
The slopes of Pisgah are mentioned as part of the boundary of the land given to the tribe of Reuben.
Moses went up on Mount Pisgah, where the Lord showed him all the Promised Land before he died.
Beth-jeshimoth is mentioned as part of the Israelites' camp in the plains of Moab.
Beth-jeshimoth is mentioned by Ezekiel as one of the cities on the east side of Moab.
